question: Can both modules and the screened spacer/head reservations occupy the existing candidate locations?
criteria_origin: Engineering screening, not user specification; unchanged 0.5 mm mount-space allowance
placement: Keep layout_v2 bottom component plane and board XY center. STEP long edge along robot X, component side +Z. This is a proposed robot transform.
envelope: Union AABB of tolerance-expanded board XY, common STEP, four spacers and heads; component height max includes the taller common STEP
stop: One placement, conservative envelopes. If collision occurs report it; do not move modules or reduce allowance to force a pass.
limits: No terminal blocks, wires, heat airflow, fastener shafts/nuts, base brackets, installation sweep or dynamic leg sweep
Board XY edge tolerance included; component/height and assembly tolerances unknown
Generic STEP does not certify 5V component placement
Fixed assemblies only; not mounting strength or production release
